blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The bribery charge against Vice President Sara Duterte will be dropped by the House prosecutors. This will end weeks of deliberations as the House prosecutors seek to shorten VP Duterte’s impeachment trial and focus on evidence they believe is sufficient to secure her conviction on other allegations. The team would formally inform the Senate impeachment court on Monday of its decision to abandon Article 3 of the impeachment complaint, which accuses Duterte of bribing Department of Education (DepEd) officials to circumvent procurement rules during her tenure as education secretary, said Manila Rep.
